title: Integrated water-depth numerical integrity policy for deliberately coarse Richards reductions
purpose: Test whether strongly coarse Richards reductions can be hydrologically evaluated under a timestep- and grid-aware research numerical-integrity policy expressed in integrated water-depth error rather than by inheriting the full-order fixed residual-rate threshold.

independent_basis.authority: Pre-existing F-ROM/F-KT accepted-transaction hard water-ledger gate, fixed before D2-D4.
independent_basis.P2E06_P2E07_context: Pre-existing Reference-only evidence showed that fixed residual-rate criteria can become dominated by representation/cancellation scales as dt changes. D4 does not fit any D2 or D3 residual magnitude.
independent_basis.D3_role: D3 is retained only as a negative result showing that the prospective ulp-bound policy is unusable. Its observed ratios do not enter D4.

trigger: direct failed-workspace diagnosis is RETRY_TOTAL_ONLY or RETRY_LOCAL_BALANCE
head convergence flag count is zero
committed state, time, revision and lineage remain bitwise/identity unchanged

depth_budget.rationale: If every compartment is at its local gate, the L1 sum of local integrated residual magnitudes is bounded by the same pre-existing 1e-12 cm water-depth scale as the accepted transaction mass gate.

accepted_candidate_checks: no internal retry and no kernel retry
water content within B01 residual/saturated physical bounds
finite bottom exchange and terminal bottom flux
research_numerical_policy.fail_closed: Head or mixed failures, pre-reattempt integrated-budget failure, failed reattempt, nonfinite state, physical-bound failure or hard accepted mass failure stop that geometry/history. No third policy or post-result widening is allowed.
research_numerical_policy.boundary: Research-only reduced-model numerical integrity. This is not a production Reference tolerance and does not claim numerical equivalence to R16.

hydrological_evaluation.reference: R16 under the same D4 strict-first integrated-water-depth policy
hydrological_evaluation.reporting: Absolute and relative development discrepancies are reported by history and pooled. They are not converted into application thresholds.
frontier_views: balance fidelity versus node count and nonlinear work
event/flux fidelity versus node count and nonlinear work

decisions.retention: A completed geometry is retained as a candidate only if integrity passes and it is non-dominated on at least one declared multi-objective development frontier. Completion alone is not application acceptance.
decisions.next_if_positive: Carry retained R4/R2 and R8 into comparison against a clean-sheet layered/quasi-steady physical reduction.
decisions.next_if_negative: No further coarse-Richards numerical-policy widening. Move to layered/quasi-steady physical reduction.
